rv.q: This well-crafted, life-opening drama, beautifully directed and performed, has subtly changed us all.
Compelling, atmospheric revival of two of Caryl Churchill’s uncompromisingly oblique one-act plays
Both plays are unflinching observations on the pains and perils of living and of dying yet both are peppered with wry humour and wit that a strong cast delight in.
It is a rewarding one that leaves you with much food for thought.
Escaped Alone and What If If Only double bill at the Royal Exchange Theatre is a complex yet thrilling theatrical treat that should not be missed.
